2.  **One Queen per Column:** Exactly one queen in each column (1 to 7).
3.  **One Queen per Region:** The board is divided into regions labeled A, B, C, D, E, F, G. There are exactly 7 distinct regions. I need to place exactly one queen in each region.
4.  **No Touching Rule (Modified):** Queens may not touch, including diagonally. This means if a queen is at $(r_1, c_1)$ and another at $(r_2, c_2)$, they cannot be adjacent horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. Specifically, $|r_1 - r_2| \le 1$ implies $|c_1 - c_2| > 1$. Since we have one per row, $|r_1 - r_2|$ is at least 1 for distinct rows. So, if queens are in consecutive rows ($|r_1 - r_2| = 1$), their columns must differ by more than 1 ($|c_1 - c_2| \ge 2$).
